collegeFullAddress: CRPF Gate No. 3, Digdoh Hills, Hingna Road, Nagpur, Maharashtra 440016
collegeInfo: G.H. Raisoni College of Engineering (GHRCE), Nagpur, established in 1996, is one of the leading private engineering colleges in Maharashtra. Accredited by NAAC (A+), NBA, and approved by AICTE, GHRCE is well-known for its quality technical education, innovative research, strong industry linkages, and robust placement record with top global recruiters.

scholarships.amount: Variable, as per government and institutional norms
scholarships.eligibilityCriteria: Awarded to students with outstanding performance in qualifying examinations (JEE Main/MHT-CET).
scholarships.applicationProcess: Eligible students are identified at the time of admission and guided to apply via the scholarship portal.

scholarships.eligibilityCriteria: Open to eligible candidates as per central and Maharashtra state government norms (SC/ST/OBC/minorities/economically weaker sections).
scholarships.applicationProcess: Apply online through the state/national scholarship portals with required documentation.

events.eventFullDescription: Pratishtha is the annual national-level technical festival of GHRCE. It attracts participants from across the country to compete in robotics, coding, paper presentations, and various engineering challenges. Workshops and guest lectures by industry leaders also feature prominently.

SPANDAN is GHRCE's primary cultural fest, offering students an opportunity to showcase talent in dance, music, drama, literary arts, and photography. The festival promotes diversity and creativity within the student community.

infrastructure.infraDescription: GHRCE sits on a 20-acre modern campus featuring smart classrooms, a central library with 1 lakh+ volumes, state-of-the-art laboratories, innovation centers, and auditoriums. The Wi-Fi enabled campus includes hostels, sports complex, gymnasium, medical facilities, and green spaces for recreation.
